name: Nexg Bina Berhad
overview: 2026年，Nexg Bina Berhad 未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项；公告主要为诉讼事项、定期财报及股东大会相关文件。
overview_en: In 2026, Nexg Bina Berhad did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract wins for its business segments in its announcements; announcements mainly related to litigation matters, periodic financial reports, and general meeting documents.
